content_text: Not sure where to send this , so hope this not inappropriate. Just wanted to send personal thanks To James and Roger. After 10 years work I am about to screen my feature film project in Paris at the end of the month. I would not have been able to get through last few years if it hadn’t been for the podcast. Almost every episode is a lesson in compassion and creativity. Thank You. S
